summary: Development/test safety and validation-harness release. The destructive-test guard now proves both a test_* database and a non-production, non-superuser PostgreSQL role before any TransactionTestCase flush, failing closed. Browser tests close Playwright-context DB connections; stale Update Center fixtures and deck-lifecycle thread assertions are corrected. Tests and docs only: no runtime, migration, package, systemd, nginx or static changes. No service restarts.
